title: Resource contracts
description: ResourceSpec (21 §4 Resource; 00 §4 amendment, §4.2 Regeneration, §4.3 Resources), owned by resource@1.

ResourceInt.description: A resource bound, value or amount: a 32-bit signed integer, so that every derived value (regeneration, costs, adjustments) stays exact in every kernel's arithmetic.

ResourceSpec.description: A typed bounded integer resource each body holds (21 §4 Resource), keyed in CompiledCartridge.resources by DefinitionRefString of kind resource: inclusive bounds minimum <= start <= maximum (RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID otherwise), start its value on a new body, and gain its regeneration per game hour: each hour boundary the clock crosses (floor(time / 3600) increases) adds gain, stopping at maximum; that stop is the regeneration rule, never a clamp of an adjustment (delta.schema.json resource.adjust). The value is derived, never ticked (02 derived state): it is stored only when written. A body's resources belong to the body, not the character driving it (owner decision on puppeting). Keys hp, ma and mv are the engine's default pools (00 §4 amendment, DikuMUD): the compiler adds them to every loka-cartridge-v2 cartridge, with resource@1, as hp 0..20 start 20 gain 5, ma 0..100 start 100 gain 4 and mv 0..82 start 82 gain 18, each field overridable in the source's resources.json; mv is the pool a move pays 1 from (movement@1), in a cartridge that declares it. resource@1 emits no events.
